selector.rationale: The lesion's description as a smooth, regular, and soft mass with a partly fatty appearance on MRI supports Congenital lipoma, which is a type of benign tumor composed of fat tissue.

rejected.label: Teratoma
rejected.why: Teratomas are typically more complex and contain multiple tissue types, which is not indicated in the vignette.

rejected.label: Congenital granular cell tumor
rejected.why: The description does not specifically mention granular cells, which are characteristic of this tumor type.

rejected.label: Congenital lingual granule cell tumor
rejected.why: The vignette does not provide specific evidence supporting the presence of lingual granule cells.

rejected.label: Hamartoma
rejected.why: While hamartomas can present as benign masses, the partly fatty appearance and other characteristics described are more specifically suggestive of a Congenital lipoma.
